component_ablation.primary_endpoint: paired full-minus-reduced on-time completion fraction at rho=1.2, tau=50 ms, CV=1.0
component_ablation.primary_multiplicity: Holm correction across the three component comparisons
component_ablation.secondary_analysis: global Holm correction across 162 full-minus-reduced condition comparisons

hybrid_trace_replay.selection: combine code and conversation traces, sort chronologically, and partition the first 18000 records into 30 non-overlapping 600-request blocks

mapping.arrival: chronological inter-arrival spacings linearly rescaled to a 5000-ms horizon
mapping.uplink_work: within-block ranks of ContextTokens mapped to 5--15 units
mapping.service_quantile: within-block ranks of GeneratedTokens mapped to open-interval empirical quantiles
mapping.deadline: fresh seeded Uniform(15,60) ms draw shared across policies

hybrid_trace_replay.interpretation: hybrid trace replay; production timestamps and token ranks are real, while scaling, deadlines, cloud-service calibration, and background work remain modeled

hardware_microbenchmark.status: protocol frozen; target device must be supplied by the author
